chunks: From the evil of the envier when he envies.

key_terms.حَاسِدٍ: The envious person, one who harbors envy

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'From the evil of the envier when he envies' mean in Shia supplications?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this phrase is deeply rooted in the concept of 'hasad' (envy) as a destructive force that consumes the envious while harming the target, often linked to the 'evil eye'. It is frequently recited in Du'a al-Faraj and other supplications, reflecting the Imams' emphasis on seeking refuge not just from the person, but from the active manifestation of their envy. This highlights the practical spiritual defense against the unseen harms of human jealousy.
